1.note: פיסקי"ירה is taken as Peschiera (del Garda); the individual is not further identified here.

2.note: Figures kept as printed; the author himself notes that the reckoning is imprecise.

3.note: 1 Macc 14:27 gives the 18th of Elul, year 172; the Vilna text reads ח' (8th), possibly a dropped digit.

4.note: The discussion of intercalation in Pirkei de-Rabbi Eliezer is usually in ch. 8; the chapter number is kept as printed.

5.he: ד' אלפים ר"ם ליצירה (היינו תתי"א לשטרות)
5.note: On the standard equation (Seleucid year = AM − 3449), 4240 AM corresponds to 791, not 811; the figure is kept as printed.

6.note: The sense seems to be that, had the Sanhedrin still existed, its number could simply have been checked in its chamber; the rendering is tentative.
